description: Reference package for searching Korean statutes and legal materials through Korean Law MCP. Not runtime-enabled and not legal advice.

required_credentials.description: National Law Information Center open API key, when using a direct or self-hosted Korean Law MCP path.
Approved Korean Law MCP endpoint. Must be reviewed before App Store runtime use.

failure_modes.message: Korean Law MCP endpoint or LAW_OC credential is not configured.
Legal result lacks official source metadata.
Law name, article, paragraph, or effective date could not be verified.
Korean Law MCP or upstream law API is unavailable.

rules: Do not present legal output as attorney advice.
Show law name, article, paragraph when available, effective date, and source.
Prefer official National Law Information Center or Ministry of Government Legislation sources.
If citation verification fails, mark the result failed rather than partial.
When user action has legal consequence, advise consulting a qualified professional.
Do not expose externalMCP as App Store runtime until separately approved.
